description: This file defines the interface 'EntityConstraintViolationListInterface' for handling validation violations on Drupal entities, extending Symfony's violation list with additional filtering and retrieval methods.

classes.name: EntityConstraintViolationListInterface
classes.description: An interface extending Symfony's ConstraintViolationListInterface with additional methods for filtering and retrieving entity validation violations.

methods.name: getEntityViolations
methods.description: Retrieves violations flagged at the entity level, not associated with specific fields.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves violations for a specific field by name.

methods.name: getByFields
methods.description: Retrieves violations for a set of specified fields.

methods.name: findByCodes
methods.description: Filters violations by specific error codes.

methods.name: filterByFields
methods.description: Filters violations to include only specified fields.

methods.name: filterByFieldAccess
methods.description: Filters violations to include only accessible fields for a given user account.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns the list of all violated field names.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity object that has been validated.
